official_definition: Subject identifier concatenated with the data-collection event (for example V1, V2, or V3).
analysis_transformation: Event-level linkage key. Subject-table values are converted to string and stripped of surrounding whitespace. Structural archive keys are renamed/canonicalized to id_event before one-to-one linkage. A participant-level id is derived separately from id_event where required.

official_definition: Number of days from the initial visit in HCA or AABC; that is, days elapsed since V1.
analysis_transformation: Converted to numeric and expressed relative to the frozen outcome-specific anchor day: anchor_days_from_V1 for structural MRI and anchor_day for ASL/cognition. Divide elapsed days by FIVE_YEAR_DAYS to obtain t5; t5_mid = t5 - 0.5. Final analysis data additionally define t5_person_centered = t5 - participant mean(t5). Cognition excludes negative elapsed time before this transformation.

analysis_name: age_open (source metadata only; final age covariates use anchor_age)
official_definition: Age in years, truncated at age 90. Because of this truncation, participants aged 90 or older may appear to have the same age across visits separated by several years.
analysis_transformation: Read from subject-event metadata and carried through intermediate visit tables, but not used directly by prepare_outcome_data. Final model age variables are instead derived from frozen roster anchor_age as age0, age0_c = (age0 - 60)/10, and age0_sq_c = age0_c^2.

official_definition: Sex at birth, coded M for male and F for female.
analysis_transformation: Carried from subject-event metadata without numerical recoding in this preparation script; converted to string in final analysis data. Rows missing required analysis fields are removed before modeling.

official_definition: Recruitment site: MGH, UCLA, Uminn, or WashU.
analysis_transformation: Event-level site is carried into final analysis data and converted to string. For ASL, site_scanner is formed as site + ' | ' + scanner. Cognition retains event-level site but forms site_scanner from frozen anchor_site and anchor_scanner.

For ASL, scanner is combined with event-level site as site + ' | ' + scanner. For cognition, the analogous adjustment uses frozen anchor_site and anchor_scanner. Structural outcome analysis does not add site_scanner.

official_definition: NIH Toolbox Cognition Fluid Composite uncorrected standard score. The score uses a normative mean of 100 and SD of 15 and compares performance with the nationally representative NIH Toolbox normative sample without age or other demographic correction.
analysis_transformation: Coerced to numeric and renamed fluid_cognition; retain values between 1 and 200 inclusive. Eligible observations must occur on or after the frozen anchor day; duplicate participant/day observations are removed. Participants must have at least two retained observations spanning at least 365 days.

official_definition: Left and right lateral-ventricle volumes from FreeSurfer aseg structural segmentation statistics. AABC structural asegstats.csv contains FreeSurfer subcortical-structure volumes in the subject's physical space; volume units are mm^3.
analysis_transformation: Sum left and right lateral-ventricle values, requiring both components (min_count=2), then apply log1p. Compute center and scale from each participant's first nonmissing transformed observation in the frozen n=622 structural cohort and define lateral_ventricles = -(x - center)/scale.
author_verification: VERIFIED: official AABC imaging-IDP Appendix 2 + FreeSurfer aseg documentation

official_definition: Left and right hippocampal volumes from FreeSurfer aseg structural segmentation statistics. AABC structural asegstats.csv contains FreeSurfer subcortical-structure volumes in the subject's physical space; volume units are mm^3.
analysis_transformation: Sum left and right hippocampal values, requiring both components (min_count=2). Compute center and scale from each participant's first nonmissing value in the frozen n=622 structural cohort and define hippocampus = (x - center)/scale.
author_verification: VERIFIED: official AABC imaging-IDP Appendix 2 + FreeSurfer aseg documentation

official_definition: FreeSurfer Estimated Total Intracranial Volume (eTIV), in mm^3. FreeSurfer computes eTIV from the scaling in the Talairach transform; it is not a direct count of voxels inside the skull.
analysis_transformation: After sorting structural visits by participant, days_from_V1, and id_event, take the first nonmissing EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol per participant as baseline_icv. Standardize these baseline values across the frozen n=622 cohort as baseline_icv_z = (baseline_icv - mean)/SD. Used for lateral-ventricle and hippocampal models.

official_definition: AABC cortical IDPs defined over the HCP_MMP v1.0 cortical parcellation. Cortical_Areal_Thicknesses.csv gives mean cortical thickness in mm within each atlas area, and Cortical_Areal_Surface_Areas.csv gives cortical surface area in mm^2 within each atlas area, in the subject's physical space.
analysis_transformation: Match 360 cortical thickness fields to the corresponding surface-area fields and compute an area-weighted participant-visit mean. Set thickness_raw missing when valid parcel completeness is below 0.95. Compute center and scale from each participant's first nonmissing thickness_raw value in the frozen n=622 structural cohort and define global_mean_thickness = (x - center)/scale.

official_definition: Mean partial-volume-corrected arterial-spin-labeling cerebral blood flow within each HCP_MMP v1.0 cortical atlas area, supplied in PVEc_ASL_CBF.csv.
analysis_transformation: Select cortical ROIs using atlas rows with a nonmissing Ji Network Label. For each eligible visit, compute the NaN-aware mean of PVE-corrected cortical CBF values across those ROIs and then take the natural logarithm: global_cortical_cbf = log(nanmean(cortical CBF)).

official_definition: Mean partial-volume-corrected arterial-spin-labeling arterial transit time within each HCP_MMP v1.0 cortical atlas area, supplied in PVEc_ASL_ATT.csv.
analysis_transformation: Select cortical ROIs using atlas rows with a nonmissing Ji Network Label. For each eligible visit, compute the NaN-aware mean of PVE-corrected cortical ATT values across those ROIs: global_cortical_att = nanmean(cortical ATT).

official_definition: Analysis-derived ASL session eligibility flag. An event passes joint QC if and only if both the CBF and ATT session-specific qc_pass flags are TRUE.
analysis_transformation: ASL session-QC flag aggregated by id_event using max() when multiple QC records are present, joined to the ASL visit table, and treated as false when missing. Only visits with joint_qc_pass == True are retained; participants must subsequently have at least two retained ASL visits.
author_verification: VERIFIED: frozen ASL audit workbook; exact Boolean identity checked across all 2,789 released ASL events

official_definition: Analysis-derived participant eligibility flag. TRUE if and only if primary_score_available, joint_ge2, and primary_repeated_cognition are all TRUE.
analysis_transformation: Frozen roster eligibility flag; missing values are treated as false when selecting cognition participants. The selected observations are then independently checked in this script: fluid-cognition score 1-200, elapsed_days >= 0, duplicate participant/day observations removed, at least two retained observations, and retained span >= 365 days.
author_verification: VERIFIED: frozen ASL audit workbook; exact Boolean identity checked across all 1,325 participant-roster rows
